item.title: Bulletin updated at 01:50 HKT 11/Nov/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A cold front will move across the vicinity of the Pearl River Estuary this morning. Under the influence of the associated northeast monsoon, temperatures will fall progressively over the region in the next few days. It will be cooler in the morning and at night and windier. Under the influence of an intense replenishment of the monsoon, it will still be cooler and very dry over southern China in the latter part of next week. The temperature difference between day and night will be rather large.

Date/Month: 11/11 (Saturday)
Wind: East to northeast force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore and on high ground.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with one or two rain patches.
Temp range: 24 - 27 C
R.H. range: 75 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low
